name: Spell Conversion
body:
School universal; Level cleric 6, druid/shaman 6, magus 6, wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

This spell is only usable if you prepare your spells like a wizard or cleric. Upon completing this spell you can exchange one prepared spell for another you have available, via your spell list, spell book or familiar depending upon how you source your spells. The replacement spell must be the same level or lower than the one replaced. The new spell is then prepared and ready as if you had it prepared from the beginning. You may apply metamagic.
